parameters: Ten days south of the Wall the snow gives up, then the
hills, and the Kaiserstraße runs white and straight
through farmland that has never seen a demon.
Wheat. Sheep. Children. It's like walking into a story.
The Empire has had a wall between it and the Aschenfeld
for three hundred years. Walls make people forget.
